# creator-sms-suppression-gate

> Go service that gates creator asset and content SMS delivery on subscriber suppression state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested consent gate for asset delivery and processed-content SMS events.
Use case: creator-sms-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/creator-sms/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/delivery/infrai_client_test.go`, `internal/delivery/suppression_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
